Phyllodes Tumor: Histological sections: spindle cell tumor, infiltrative growth pattern, prominent sclerosis, fascicles, tapering nuclei, mild anisonucleosis
Myoepithelial markers: smooth muscle actin (SMA) and p63 showed focal, positive expression
Ki-67 (proliferation marker) showed focal positivity in less than 5% tumor cells
Tumor cells negative for: Gross cystic disease fluid protein (GCDFP), estrogen (ER), progesterone receptor (PR), S100, Desmin
Frozen sections: tumor with predominant spindle cells, mild atypia, sclerotic stroma, infiltrating adjacent fat
Interspersed foci: benign ductal hyperplasia, papillary hyperplasia, micropapilloma, chronic inflammatory cells
metaplastic carcinoma: Tumor cells positive for: cytokeratins CK, CK7, High molecular weight (HMWCK), epithelial membrane antigen (EMA), vimentin
Cells: plump, epithelioid shapes, mild atypia, occasional small cluster formation
Lumpectomy specimen: firm, grey-white, fibrous, un-encapsulated nodular tumor, 2 × 1.2 × 0.8 cm, infiltrative borders, no calcification
Mammography: 2 × 2 cm ill-defined mass with irregular margins in left upper outer quadrant, no micro-calcifications
